name: CiteSight synthetic evidence-review smoke set v1
labelStatus: Developer-authored synthetic cases and provisional labels. Not independently adjudicated or an assessment-validation dataset.

cases.statement: Practice improved recall in adults.
cases.source: Practice improved recall in adults after two weeks.

cases.source: The trial enrolled 120 participants across three clinics.

cases.statement: The intervention may improve sleep quality.
cases.source: The intervention may improve sleep quality, but the confidence interval is wide.

cases.statement: The drug did not lower blood pressure.
cases.source: The drug did not lower blood pressure in the randomized trial.

cases.statement: The program improved recall in adults and children.
cases.source: The program improved recall in adults. Children were not included in the study.

cases.statement: The intervention improved sleep and reduced anxiety.
cases.source: The intervention improved sleep. Anxiety was not measured.

cases.statement: The study found a relationship between exercise and mood and proved exercise caused the improvement.
cases.source: The study found a relationship between exercise and mood. Its observational design cannot establish causation.

cases.statement: The treatment reduced pain after one week and after a year.
cases.source: The treatment reduced pain after one week. The study did not collect year-long follow-up data.

cases.statement: The intervention increased mortality.
cases.source: The intervention decreased mortality compared with the control group.

cases.statement: The trial enrolled 200 participants.
cases.source: The trial enrolled 120 participants, not 200.

cases.statement: The researchers found a statistically significant reduction in pain.
cases.source: The researchers found no statistically significant reduction in pain.

cases.statement: The survey took place in 2022.
cases.source: The survey took place in 2019. No survey was conducted in 2022.

cases.statement: The treatment is effective in children.
cases.source: The treatment was tested in adults. Children were not studied and its effectiveness in children remains unknown.
